title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the field arrows and polar plot
body:
## Problem
The apps use red and green markers for charges and for the antenna length; some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette that stays distinguishable for common colour-blindness types, in light and dark mode, and marker shapes that differ as well.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`, `sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Positive and negative charges distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a quarter-wave antenna over a conducting plane to Session 2
body:
## Problem
Session 2 only covers the half-wave dipole; many real antennas (car radios, phones) are quarter-wave over a ground plane.

## Context
The image idea: a conductor behaves like a mirror for the wave, so half of a dipole is enough.

## Expected outcome
A function `quarter_wave_length(f)`, an exercise and a short explanation with a figure.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-02/checkpoint.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] 0.75 m for 100 MHz is reproduced by a check
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 4: an 8-element steerable array
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. Session 3 stops at two sources.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Replace the Mur boundary by a graded absorbing layer
body:
## Problem
The Mur boundary leaves a 2.3 percent echo in the `boundary_echo` test.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 2. A layer of increasing conductivity (for both E and H) absorbs more cleanly.

## Expected outcome
A new boundary option in `Yee2D` and a test that shows a smaller echo.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Echo below 0.5 percent
- [ ] Energy and stability checks still pass

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Reproduce the Target: a steerable 8-element array
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a beam swept by phase shifting; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Beam within 2 degrees of the commanded angle for five angles
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
